extra_world_events.title: Vault Bio-Lock Compromised
extra_world_events.description: The bio-lock at Patent Kiosk 04 shows signs of tampering, indicating an imminent vault breach. Spore toxicity levels are rising, complicating access for a disgraced researcher.

extra_world_events.title: Mycelial Server Room Toxicity Spike
extra_world_events.description: A sudden spike in spore toxicity within the Mycelial Server Room suggests a data extraction attempt under cover of environmental chaos. Containment protocols are failing, blocking normal access.

extra_world_events.title: Mutated Spore Outbreak Detected
extra_world_events.description: A highly aggressive, rapidly mutating spore strain has been detected in the Genetic Splicing Workshop, threatening to overwhelm containment protocols. Immediate action is required to prevent widespread infection.

extra_world_events.title: Corporate Agents Attempt Strain Extraction
extra_world_events.description: Whispers confirm corporate agents are attempting to illicitly extract samples of the newly mutated spore strain from the Bazaar Logistics Yard, aiming to weaponize or patent it. Security is compromised.

extra_world_events.title: Patent Ledger Corruption Detected
extra_world_events.description: The Biometric Ledger at Kiosk 04 is intermittently failing, displaying corrupted patent data and delaying new registrations. This suggests a deeper issue with the Patent Office's central database.

extra_world_events.title: Vault Entry Point Secured
extra_world_events.description: The compromised bio-lock at Patent Kiosk 04 has been bypassed, creating a temporary entry point into the vault. Rising spore toxicity levels make the path hazardous.

extra_world_events.title: Proprietary Genome Data Access Gained
extra_world_events.description: Amidst the server room's rising toxicity, a hacker has gained partial access to the proprietary fungal genome's data. Full extraction requires further decryption.

extra_world_events.title: Spore Containment Protocols Failing
extra_world_events.description: The mutated spore strain in the Genetic Splicing Workshop is adapting rapidly, overwhelming current containment efforts. The infection meter is rising, requiring immediate intervention.

extra_world_events.title: Corporate Team Secures Spore Sample
extra_world_events.description: Despite security, a corporate team has secured a small sample of the mutated spore strain from the Bazaar Logistics Yard. They are now seeking a buyer or a safe extraction route, creating a high-stakes trade opportunity for a black-market dealer.

extra_world_events.title: Ventilation Blight Rumors Spread
extra_world_events.description: Whispers of a synthetic blight leaking into the Spore-Cloud Lounge's ventilation system are causing panic, impacting trade and negotiations. Origins unknown.
